results.question: How do I add a YouTube video?
results.answer:
To add a YouTube video in OptiSigns:

- Go to Files/Assets and click Apps, then search for and select YouTube. 
- Paste the YouTube link into the URL field. OptiSigns accepts regular video links, share links, and Shorts links. The URL is the only required field. 
- Optional: set a Name, turn on Caption or Mute, and use Playback options to set a Start At or End At time. 
- As soon as the URL is valid, the video previews on the right so you can confirm it before saving. 
- Click Save, then assign the video to a screen, playlist, schedule, or split screen. 

Article URL: https://support.optisigns.com/hc/en-us/articles/360051014713-How-to-Use-YouTube-with-OptiSigns

results.question: How do I manage user roles in OptiSigns?
results.answer:
You can manage user roles in OptiSigns from the Account Members area. Only the Account Owner or a Super Admin can do this, and role security is available on Pro Plus plans or above. 

- Go to your user profile and open the Account Members tab. From there you can Add, Invite, Manage Roles, and Manage Members. 
- Use Manage Roles to view default roles or create custom roles. OptiSigns includes roles like Owner, Super Admin, Admin, User, Content Proposal, Content Approval, and Read Only. 
- To create a custom role, click Manage Roles, then New Role, choose the permissions, name the role, and Save. 
- To assign roles to users, choose Add or Invite, then select the role from the dropdown when adding the user. 
- To update users later, use Manage Members to reassign roles and move users between teams. 

Article URL: https://support.optisigns.com/hc/en-us/articles/360046356113-Advanced-Security-Managing-User-Roles
